spans.claim: Lionel Hipwell was accused of murder after a shooting in Bloomsbury Square
spans.anchor: Man Murdered in Bloomsbury Square. Escape of the Alleged Assassin
spans.span: Man Murdered in Bloomsbury Square. Escape of the Alleged Assassin," greeted my eyes in bold type.

spans.claim: The victim was shot in the jaw and the bullet penetrated the brain
spans.anchor: Examination showed that the dead man had been shot in the jaw
spans.span: Examination showed that the dead man had been shot in the jaw, and that the bullet had penetrated the brain.

spans.claim: Hilda Bennett accused Lionel but later denied he was the killer
spans.anchor: No, she said decisively. He’s a liar! This is not the man who killed Monkey Dick!

spans.claim: Lionel fled disguised as a lorry driver to avoid arrest
spans.anchor: He begged them to give him a lift, and they did so. On the way the stranger bought the clothes
spans.span: He begged them to give him a lift, and they did so. On the way the stranger bought the clothes and overcoat of his companion, so that when he left at Birmingham, he was disguised as a motor-driver.

spans.claim: Lionel was drugged and lost memory for two years
spans.anchor: That drug given to me by Lisely Hatten destroyed my self-will
spans.span: That drug given to me by Lisely Hatten destroyed my self-will, and rendered me inert, helpless, ignorant of my true existence.

spans.claim: Illona was Lionel’s secret wife and a member of the criminal gang
spans.anchor: Elizabeth Mary Illona Patrick, spinster, age 39, of Stafford Road, Notting Hill

spans.claim: Felix Zuroff is the leader of the criminal gang controlling jewel thieves
spans.anchor: Felix Zuroff, the most daring and desperate jewel-thief Europe has ever known
spans.span: Felix Zuroff, the most daring and desperate jewel-thief Europe has ever known and whose ramifications ran through the whole Continent, restored Lady Rathgormly's pearls to her, at my suggestion.

spans.claim: Joan Gell was kidnapped by the gang as revenge against her father
spans.anchor: She was locked in an upstairs room in a small and dirty house kept by a foreigner, named Dufour
spans.span: But, on coming to herself, she found to her horror that she was locked in an upstairs room in a small and dirty house kept by a foreigner, named Dufour, and his wife.

spans.claim: Musical manuscript is a coded message used by the gang
spans.anchor: The discovery of the musical code used by the wide-spread gang astounded me
spans.span: The discovery of the musical code used by the wide-spread gang astounded me.

spans.claim: Illona betrayed Lionel to the police and committed suicide
spans.anchor: Before she could arrest her on suspicion she committed suicide by swallowing prussic acid

spans.claim: Joan was rescued after police raid and found unconscious
spans.anchor: In the centre of a bare, miserable room was a bed, and upon it a female figure. Next second I recognized the pallid, wasted face as that of Joan
spans.span: In the centre of a bare, miserable room was a bed, and upon it a female figure. Next second I recognized the pallid, wasted face as that of Joan--_my Joan_!

spans.claim: Felix Zuroff agreed to release Lionel after Illona’s death
spans.anchor: Felix Zuroff, the most notorious motor bandit Europe had known, restord Lady Rathgormly’s pearls

spans.claim: False accusation that Lionel murdered Monkey Dick was based on misunderstanding
spans.anchor: Rodwell was a damned cur! I have since discovered that on the night in question he was on his way to Vine Street Police Station to give me away

spans.claim: Joan’s disappearance was a reprisal against her father by criminals
spans.anchor: It is a case of revenge and retaliation. That is my view
spans.span: It is a case of revenge and retaliation. That is my view.

spans.claim: Lisely Hatten spared Lionel’s eyesight despite being gang member
spans.anchor: She was then--not now. She ascertained your family connections, as you know, and intended to marry you. To her, you no doubt owe your eyesight

spans.claim: Roddy Owen fled due to police suspicion but was innocent of murder
spans.anchor: If he knows anything he shall be made to divulge it, I assure you, Mr. Hipwell

spans.claim: Illona sent a warning to Lionel about a blind man
spans.anchor: Beware of a trap, and if you meet a blind man, be careful to avoid him
spans.span: Beware of a trap, and if you meet a blind man, be careful to avoid him.

spans.claim: Lionel’s official position allowed him to travel widely and access jewels
spans.anchor: I held a post at the Foreign Office, a post which, I confess, carried with it short hours and little work

spans.claim: The pearls were hidden in a hollow book in Lionel’s possession
spans.anchor: There it was in black and white to hold in any court of law
spans.span: There it was in black and white to hold in any court of law.

spans.claim: The coded musical message warned Lionel of Illona’s betrayal
spans.anchor: Illona will betray you to the police. She is coming to London with that object. Beware of her! Trust in me
spans.span: _Illona will betray you to the police. She is coming to London with that object. Beware of her! Trust in me.
